description: False-colour satellite imagery from a Spot 5 satellite, captured on 2011-06-30, showing bare rock formations (land cover class 6.3.1.1) in Anatolia, Turkey. The image uses a Near-Infrared/Red/Green (NIR/R/G) band combination with a spatial resolution of 2.5 metres. The terrain is rugged and mountainous, characterised by exposed rock surfaces appearing in reddish-brown and light blue/teal tones, with deep shadows indicating steep slopes and valleys. The light blue/teal areas typically represent highly reflective bare ground or possibly snow/ice, while reddish-brown areas denote other types of bare rock or very sparse vegetation. The data source is CNES 2011© Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image.
